title: 북한인권기록보존소 운영규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Preservation and Management of Materials)
(1) The head of the North Korean Human Rights Archives shall establish a materials management system, preservation facilities and relevant equipment so that all materials, including documents (including electronic documents), objects (including data storage media), books, registers, cards, drawings and audiovisual materials, can be managed efficiently.
(2) Where materials in custody are deemed to have high preservation value, the head of the North Korean Human Rights Archives shall record them on preservation media or produce and manage copies thereof.
(3) Article ??0 (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Public Records Management Act shall apply mutatis mutandis to the standards for preservation facilities and equipment for preserving and managing materials transferred pursuant to Article 13 (5) of the North Korean Human Rights Act and Article 14 (3) of its Enforcement Decree. The cited article number is corrupted as "??0조제1항" in the supplied Korean source and cannot be established from that text alone.
